description.en: StocBench evaluates generative models for probabilistic forecasting of stochastic fluid flows, using a two-dimensional Kolmogorov flow with stochastic forcing, measuring one-step distributional accuracy and preservation of the enstrophy spectrum during autoregressive rollouts.
